requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A plausible faulty implementation would classify settlements with description/value/cardId heuristics, omit tenant scoping, or count a retry as a new economic expense.

risk_surfaces.reason: Heuristic or partial-source filtering could violate the canonical settlement discriminator.
The Invoice anti-join must never allow another organization/profile to affect local aggregation.
A repeated invoice payment must not create another settlement transaction.
The economic aggregate must remain correct before and after close/pay transitions.
The returned and persisted paymentTransactionId must point to the actual settlement Transaction.
Card and reports documentation must describe the same canonical semantics.
